arp_eth_rx.summary: ARP frame receiver: latches the Ethernet header, then a two-state header FSM with a word pointer extracts ARP fields byte-by-byte from the AXI-Stream payload and emits them in parallel with valid/ready plus error flags (8-bit, one byte per beat).

blocks.name: Header parse controller
blocks.description: Two-state parser and word pointer sequencing Ethernet then ARP header capture

anchors.name: read_arp_header_reg
anchors.why: Header-parse state: enables ARP field capture from payload words

anchors.name: read_eth_header_reg
anchors.why: Waiting-for-Ethernet-header state of the two-state parser

anchors.name: ptr_reg
anchors.why: Payload word counter selecting which ARP header field is captured

anchors.name: store_eth_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable latching Ethernet header fields

blocks.name: Ethernet input
blocks.description: Header and payload handshakes feeding the parser

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Ethernet header valid starting frame parse

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready while idle and output not pending

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Payload bytes carrying ARP header fields

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload beat valid advancing header parse

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready asserted while consuming frame

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of frame triggering validation and output

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte-valid mask; unused here since KEEP_ENABLE is 0 at 8-bit width

blocks.name: ARP field registers
blocks.description: Registers holding decoded Ethernet and ARP header fields

anchors.name: m_arp_oper
anchors.why: Decoded ARP operation field output

anchors.name: m_arp_sha
anchors.why: Decoded sender hardware address

anchors.name: m_arp_spa
anchors.why: Decoded sender protocol address

anchors.name: m_arp_tpa
anchors.why: Decoded target protocol address

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Latched Ethernet destination MAC

blocks.name: Frame output and status
blocks.description: Output valid/ready and busy/error status flags

anchors.name: m_frame_valid
anchors.why: Decoded ARP frame valid after complete, valid header

anchors.name: m_frame_ready
anchors.why: Downstream accept clearing frame valid

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy while ARP header is being read

anchors.name: error_header_early_termination
anchors.why: Pulse when frame ends before full ARP header

anchors.name: error_invalid_header
anchors.why: Pulse when HLEN/PLEN are invalid

arp_eth_tx.summary: ARP frame transmitter: latches parallel ARP header fields on a valid/ready handshake, then a pointer-driven serializer emits the 28-byte ARP payload onto AXI-stream through a skid output buffer.

blocks.name: Header capture
blocks.description: Latches ARP and Ethernet header fields on accepted frame.

anchors.name: store_frame
anchors.why: Load enable latching all input ARP and Ethernet header fields.

anchors.name: arp_sha_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched ARP header field held while payload is serialized.

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Latched Ethernet destination MAC driving output header field.

blocks.name: Header serializer control
blocks.description: Send flag and pointer sequence the 28-byte header emission and input ready.

anchors.name: send_arp_header_reg
anchors.why: Two-state controller: set on frame accept, cleared after last header byte.

anchors.name: ptr_reg
anchors.why: Byte pointer selecting which ARP header field is emitted each cycle.

anchors.name: s_frame_ready
anchors.why: Frame ready, high when no header pending or payload being sent.

anchors.name: s_frame_valid
anchors.why: Input frame valid; with s_frame_ready triggers header field capture.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy level output mirroring header transmission in progress.

blocks.name: Payload byte mux
blocks.description: Selects header bytes into AXI lanes per ptr_reg, sets tkeep and tlast.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Serialized header byte lanes selected by ptr_reg before output buffer.

blocks.name: Ethernet header output
blocks.description: Header valid/ready handshake presenting latched MAC addresses and ethertype.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Ethernet header valid, set on frame accept, cleared by m_eth_hdr_ready.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready that clears header valid.

blocks.name: AXI output skid buffer
blocks.description: Output and temp registers decoupling payload from downstream tready stalls.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready gating header serialization and output buffer loading.

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp data register used when output stalls.

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp register occupancy flag controlling early ready and output refill.

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal payload directly into the output register.

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads internal payload into temp register when output stalled.

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp register contents into output register.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI-stream payload output carrying serialized ARP header bytes.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output AXI-stream valid from the output register.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready steering skid buffer transfers and internal ready.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker set on the final header byte.

arp_cache.summary: Direct-mapped ARP cache: CRC32 LFSR hashes of IP addresses index valid/IP/MAC memories; queries compare stored IP for hit or error, writes are registered then committed, and clear sweeps all entries.

blocks.name: Cache memories
blocks.description: Direct-mapped valid, IP tag and MAC arrays.

anchors.name: ip_addr_mem
anchors.why: Stored IP tag per entry, compared against queried IP for hit detection.

anchors.name: mac_addr_mem
anchors.why: Stored MAC per entry, read out as query response.

anchors.name: valid_mem
anchors.why: Per-entry valid bit, cleared by cache sweep, qualifies hits.

anchors.name: mem_write
anchors.why: Memory write enable for entry commit or clear sweep.

blocks.name: Query path
blocks.description: Hash query IP, read entry, compare tag, return MAC or error.

anchors.name: query_request_valid
anchors.why: Query request valid accepting a lookup IP.

anchors.name: query_request_ready
anchors.why: Query ready, low during cache clear or stalled response.

anchors.name: query_request_ip
anchors.why: Lookup IP hashed into cache index.

anchors.name: query_response_valid
anchors.why: Query response valid with MAC and error.

anchors.name: query_response_ready
anchors.why: Downstream response ready clearing response valid.

anchors.name: query_response_mac
anchors.why: MAC read from cache for the queried IP.

anchors.name: query_response_error
anchors.why: Miss indication when entry invalid or IP tag mismatches.

anchors.name: query_ip_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pending query flag; triggers lookup compare and response generation.

anchors.name: query_ip_reg
anchors.why: Latched query IP compared with stored IP tag.

anchors.name: store_query
anchors.why: Load enable latching query IP on request accept.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Query index from IP hash addressing valid/IP/MAC memories.

anchors.name: query_request_hash
anchors.why: LFSR hash of query IP, low bits load rd_ptr.

blocks.name: Write and clear path
blocks.description: Hash write IP, latch IP/MAC and commit; clear sweeps wr_ptr over all entries.

anchors.name: write_request_valid
anchors.why: Write request valid inserting an IP/MAC pair.

anchors.name: write_request_ready
anchors.why: Write ready, low during cache clear.

anchors.name: write_request_mac
anchors.why: MAC to store for the written IP.

anchors.name: write_ip_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pending write flag committing latched IP/MAC to memories.

anchors.name: write_ip_reg
anchors.why: Latched write IP/MAC awaiting commit to cache memories.

anchors.name: store_write
anchors.why: Load enable latching write IP/MAC on request accept.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write index from IP hash, or sweep counter during cache clear.

anchors.name: write_request_hash
anchors.why: LFSR hash of write IP, low bits load wr_ptr.

arp.summary: ARP engine: rx/tx frame submodules plus a hashed ARP cache; combinational next-state logic answers incoming requests, caches sender addresses, and resolves lookups with timed retry broadcasts.

blocks.name: Lookup request controller
blocks.description: Resolves lookup requests via cache, broadcasts ARP requests with retry timer

anchors.name: arp_request_operation_reg
anchors.why: Pending-lookup state: drives retries, timer, cache polling and response completion

anchors.name: arp_request_valid
anchors.why: Lookup request valid starting subnet check and cache query

anchors.name: arp_request_ready
anchors.why: Lookup ready, high only when idle with no pending response

anchors.name: arp_request_ip
anchors.why: IP to resolve; checked for broadcast and subnet, sent to cache

anchors.name: arp_request_retry_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Remaining ARP request retransmissions

anchors.name: arp_request_timer_reg
anchors.why: Retry interval / timeout timer triggering resend or failure

blocks.name: Lookup response
blocks.description: Registered response valid, error and MAC outputs

anchors.name: arp_response_valid
anchors.why: Lookup response valid from cache hit, broadcast or timeout

anchors.name: arp_response_ready
anchors.why: Consumer ready clearing response valid

anchors.name: arp_response_error
anchors.why: Lookup failed after retries exhausted

anchors.name: arp_response_mac
anchors.why: Resolved MAC from cache or broadcast MAC

blocks.name: ARP cache access
blocks.description: Query and write request registers to the hashed ARP cache

anchors.name: cache_query_request_valid_reg
anchors.why: Cache query request valid to arp_cache

anchors.name: cache_query_request_ip_reg
anchors.why: IP held for cache query (request or gateway IP)

anchors.name: cache_query_response_valid
anchors.why: Cache query result valid

anchors.name: cache_query_response_error
anchors.why: Cache miss flag launching ARP request broadcast

anchors.name: cache_query_response_mac
anchors.why: MAC returned on cache hit

anchors.name: cache_write_request_valid_reg
anchors.why: Writes received sender IP/MAC into ARP cache

anchors.name: cache_write_request_ip_reg
anchors.why: Sender IP to store in cache

anchors.name: cache_write_request_mac_reg
anchors.why: Sender MAC to store in cache

blocks.name: Frame receiver
blocks.description: Parses incoming Ethernet frames into ARP fields

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Incoming Ethernet header valid to receiver

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Incoming Ethernet payload bytes parsed into ARP fields

anchors.name: incoming_frame_valid
anchors.why: Parsed ARP frame valid from receiver

anchors.name: incoming_frame_ready
anchors.why: Accepts parsed frame when transmitter is ready

anchors.name: incoming_arp_oper
anchors.why: Received opcode selecting ARP vs InARP reply

blocks.name: Frame transmitter
blocks.description: Builds and serializes outgoing ARP reply/request frames

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Outgoing Ethernet header valid from transmitter

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Outgoing serialized ARP payload bytes

anchors.name: outgoing_frame_valid_reg
anchors.why: Requests transmission of ARP reply or request frame

anchors.name: outgoing_frame_ready
anchors.why: Transmitter ready, also gates incoming frame acceptance

anchors.name: outgoing_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Destination MAC of outgoing frame (requester or broadcast)

anchors.name: outgoing_arp_oper_reg
anchors.why: Outgoing ARP opcode: request, reply or InARP reply

anchors.name: outgoing_arp_tpa_reg
anchors.why: Target protocol address of outgoing frame

blocks.name: Network configuration
blocks.description: Local addresses, gateway and subnet configuration inputs

anchors.name: local_mac
anchors.why: Local MAC used as sender address and InARP match

anchors.name: local_ip
anchors.why: Local IP matched against incoming request target

anchors.name: gateway_ip
anchors.why: Gateway IP looked up for off-subnet requests

anchors.name: subnet_mask
anchors.why: Subnet mask for on-subnet and broadcast checks
